summary.text: In 2025, Powell described AI-related investment and data-center construction as contributors to economic growth. In June 2025, he described AI as having transformational potential while noting that it could both create and replace jobs. In January 2026, he discussed potential productivity and income gains alongside job disruption, while emphasizing uncertainty about AI’s overall effects.

statements.text: So this is the question. The question really is, will AI be more augmenting labor or replacing labor? And I wouldn’t—I, I—we all see those announcements, including one today.
